events.text: Tuelhalva Drakewings of the Cult of the Dragon discovers Gargauth, the exiled archdevil, who is trapped in a pit in Peleveran. Gargauth persuades Tuelhalva to break from the Banite-led Sembian cell of the cult, and Tuelhalva begins plotting his move. Over the next five years, rival factions grow within the Dragon Cult, dominated by Algashon Nathaire's Bane-following reformational branch and Tuelhalva's own more pragmatic group.

events.text: Early in the year, after overcoming many trials and traps, three priests of Abbathor breach the plundered (by Abbathor himself) treasure vault of the ghost dragon Ragflaconshen under Turnback Mountain. Following a vision sent by the Great Master of Greed, they direct all followers of Abbathor to bring their collected hoards here and eventually it becomes Aefarn, the greatest temple to Abbathor and perhaps the most valuable collection of treasure in the Realms.

events.text: Dragons wreak havoc across the kingdom of Cormyr. They raze Arabel, Dhedluk, Eveningstar, and a score of other settlements. Three red dragons and the black dragon Thauglorimorgorus, the famed Purple Dragon, descend upon Suzail, laying waste to much of the city. High Mage Thanderahast is seriously injured in airborne combat against Thauglorimorgorus. The Black Doom is finally defeated in the King's Forest in Cormyr after being lured into a trap and grounded. Crown Prince Azoun II lays the final blow with the aid of Jorunhast, apprentice to the Mage Royal, piercing Thauglor's brain with the sword Orbyn.

events.text: When the king of Westgate is slain by a red dragon and dies without an heir, the mercenary lord Sarvyn Eorn is acclaimed as his successor. Sarvyn reverses the Templeban Edict, allowing religious buildings back inside the city. The hills outside the walls where divine rites have been performed for the past 91 years (since 927 DR) are abandoned and eventually become known as the Hills of the Seven Lost Gods.

cites: City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 45

events.text: On the night of the 7th full moon of the year, Alathene brings evidence to the courts of her brother committing arson, theft, murder, and slavery. She asks that he be stripped of his title and banished. The Lords of Waterdeep order Vanrak's immediate capture, but by the time the Watch breach the gates of Moonstar Villa, he and his followers have disappeared through a secret portal into Undermountain.
cites: City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 45

events.text: A horde of undead emerging from the Fields of the Dead threatens Baldur's Gate with destruction.
cites: Dungeon 131: Prison Mail, с. 12

events.text: Shevas Tam turns the Thayan Guild of Portagers into zombies and establishes the Long Portage along the River Thay.
cites: Spellbound: Campaign Guide, с. 20,127

events.text: Queen Bethany Carrathal of Callidyrr dies of illness.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: Edwin Carrathal II becomes King of Callidyrr.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: Emperor Shin Lu of Shou Lung passes away after 70 years of rule. He is given the deific name of "Ying", or "Eagle". His son becomes the second Emperor Chin.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 119

events.text: King Edwin Carrathal II of Callidyrr dies while touring an iron mine near Cantrev Whiterock.
Queen Eleanor, wife of the deceased King Edwin II, appoints Adom Kimball as regent of Callidyrr because Edwin II's son and sole heir, Adrian, is only ten years old.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: The village of Hespheira, having been transported from the Sword Mountains to the Plane of Shadow in the , briefly returns, wrapped in a cloying cloud of blackness. Shadowy creatures and the shadow dragon dracolich Umbralax begin attacking inhabitants of the surrounding region, forced back only by the Knights of the Aster.

The drow family House Jaezred returns to Chaulssin, where they found the House of Hidden Masters. Now calling themselves the Jaezred Chaulssin, they establish secret fosterages in seven drow cities, each dominated by followers of Lolth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 120

events.text: After only six years of rule, second Emperor Chin of Shou Lung passes away with age and is given the deific name of "Tz'u Wei" (Hedgehog). He is succeeded by his grandson, the third Emperor Chin.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 120

events.text: The monocle of Bagthalos, a relic sacred to Helm, is fashioned by Bagthalos Deszhummer in Zazesspur.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Amn, с. 21

events.text: Strife, the sixth High Imperceptor of Bane, is killed by Harpers.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Adventure Book, с. 41

events.text: Bagthalos Deszhummer, Archpriest of Helm, dies as he completes the monocle of Bagthalos.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Amn, с. 21
Book of Artifacts, с. 61

events.text: In Kozakura, the wu jen Ch'u Tei Zao and Goboro the Lame, one standing atop Mount Kaza and the other on the neighboring peak of Dagorayama, engage in a murderous duel of sorcery to end their 237-year-old feud. A climactic explosion destroys the peak of Mount Kaza and nobody knows the end of the duel.
cites: Swords of the Daimyo, с. 17

events.text: Due to a duel between the wu jens Ch'u Tei Zao and Goboro the Lame, the summit of Kazayama was destroyed.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 137

events.text: Adrian Carrathal becomes King of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: A group of evil Vaasan wizards erect a tower made of ice at the base of Mount Okk and succeed in developing a new type of cold magic. They use this new power to amass precious gems and metals, storing them in the tower's labyrinthine cellar and guarding them with magically created ice monsters.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 5–7

events.text: The Amcathra family is ennobled in Waterdeep.

A number of Inner Sea pirates choose to retire to Aglarond, among them the infamous Redsail. They bring their immense booty with them, and in addition to spending big on carousing and introducing crime, they also invest extensively but secretly in legitimate local merchant shipping, businesses, and property. This reduces the southern coastal lands' mercantile dominance on Inner Sea trade.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 1190

events.text: The pureblood yuan-ti mages of the Coiled Cabal awake after centuries and attempt to conquer the Cities of the Seabreeze, beginning with Sammaresh. Two dozen archmages of Tashluta and Lapaliiya battle them in a season of savage spell-battles along the Tashtan Coast, in conflict known as the Rage of Wizards. The cities of Lapaliiya and Tashalar suffer severe damage.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 120

events.text: Shell House, a temple to Umberlee in Ilyaport, is destroyed amidst the Rage of Wizards. The Orglara, a relic that the Shell Priests of that temple kept safe, is sucked out to sea by a great wave.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 67

events.text: Anger over the Rage of Wizards in Lapaliiya sees a corresponding rise in respect for priests, leading to the establishment of the civic faiths that dominate each city.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 120

events.text: The Skeletal Finger thieves guild steals the monocle of Bagthalos from the House of the Steadfast, a Helmite temple in Zazesspur.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Amn, с. 21

events.text: 2–3 Marpenoth: A group of adventurers chase down a drow slaving expedition near Rothé Valley, and discover the area has long been used as a trap by House Xorlarrin to lure in settlers for eventual enslavement. The adventuring party is lost in the tunnels beneath the valley before they can report their findings to the world.

In aerial combat above the Shining Sea east of Orlil, Ootheraum Deirin, an archmage from Halruaa, slays the ancient blue dragon Thoklastees. It is said that this battle inspired the Lantanna to begin their research into building their own skyships.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 120
Prayers from the Faithful, с. 114

events.text: Jorist Archneie, a young but ambitious priest of Umberlee, discovers The Orglara and uses it to challenge his superiors in the church hierarchy. The power struggle weakens the church at first but the survivors emerge stronger and wiser. These challenges become semi-regular occurrences known as "the Scouring Storm" in Umberlaunt faith. Jorist comes to head the Church of the Deeps at Tharsult, the most powerful temple at the time.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 68

events.text: King Alemander I of Tethyr dies.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: Coram III, great-grandson of Alemander, is crowned king of Tethyr.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: Elthond Olósynne, a future King of Aglarond, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 74

events.text: The mage Akhlaur summons larakens—creatures able to absorb magic—through a portal to the Elemental Plane of Water and deposits them in the swamp around his tower.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 120

events.text: The First Prior of Sunrise Spire, a monastery dedicated to Lathander on the north bank of the River Chionthar several days upstream from Baldur's Gate, is blasted to ashes at his altar when he challenges Lathander himself after a crisis of faith.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 94

events.text: The ruling families of Sheirtalar and Lushpool unite and install the Overking of Lapaliiya, Haliim.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121

events.text: The "Lord of Bones", the necromancer Shradin Mulophor, asks Halaster Blackcloak for permission to occupy the former site of the Sargauth Enclave, forming a new trading post that is later to develop into Skullport. Shradin links the River Sargauth with other subterranean waterways and creates portals to faraway seas, developing trade with other powers of the Underdark.
cites: Skullport, с. 6
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121

events.text: The Ice Castle of the Vaasan wizards in the Lugsaas Chain is destroyed by an avalanche after an earthquake strikes the region.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 7

events.text: Sailors that were thought lost at sea begin turning up on shore. They are all now working for the Kraken Society as their first land-bound agents.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes

events.text: Wai Long Hwa is recognized as the third emperor of the Lui Dynasty of T'u Lung and the Maki Clan becomes more powerful by supporting him. The Three Kingdoms are reunited and the Ho and Tan families are defeated, but remain strong. The Yang family is given control of its lands.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121

events.text: H'dang Li, High Lord of Oceans, chooses his successor before disappearing into the mountains of Tabot.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume I, с. 74

events.text: Alemander II, future king of Tethyr is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: Orc and troll tribes make increased numbers of attacks on the Sword Coast.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121–122

events.text: Ibun Rensha of Calimshan and several family members raise an army of mercenaries. They seize Loudwater and claim much of the Delimbiyr Vale.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121–122

events.text: Borran Klosk, a mohrg in service to Malar, leads an army of undead in an attack on the cities of the Vilhon Reach. The Vilhon cities are aided by the dwarves of the Alaoreum and the druids of the Emerald Enclave. The armies clash at the Battle of Morningstar Hollows, where the druids raise the Alaoreum River and flood the undead force. Borran Klosk cannot be destroyed, but clerics of Eldath imprison him beneath the city of Alaghôn.
Circa: Chondath experiences a resurgence in power. Its mercenaries forces begin to be lent to many foreign wars, particularly the internal fighting in Chessenta.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121–122

events.text: Several satraps and shaleiras are found dead in their beds in Calimport. The only clue to the cause of their deaths is a single burn mark. The murderer is eventually caught in the act of killing the Ongalar but whoever the culprit is escapes underground without their identity being revealed despite numerous powerful divinations.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 26

events.text: Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun the Elder arrives for the first time in Waterdeep and constructs Arunsun (later Blackstaff) Tower.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121–122
City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 30

events.text: A terrible plague spreads through the Sword Coast area.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121–122
City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 30

events.text: Plague and conflict on the Sword Coast leads to a rise in worship of Talona and Loviatar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 121–122

events.text: In its first effort to reopen a trade route to Mulhorand, Durpar launches an expeditionary force to Veldorn to eliminate the monsters there. However, every monster power comes to the defense of every other, and the campaign ends in failure.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 122

events.text: The Rose-Red Shield, a famous group of Lathander-worshiping adventurers, loses its well-respected party priest to old age. The priests' four novice followers fight amongst themselves for possession of his relic, the Tome of the Morning. One is killed and the other banished from the party before the remaining two agree to share the holy book.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 94

events.text: Shou Lung forces make the Twenty-Ninth Incursion into T'u Lung, in which they attack the city of Balanzia. The city walls are breached for the sixth time in history. However, an ancient curse is triggered, driving the citizens mad and they flee the city.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 122
Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume I, с. 43

events.text: In Chessenta, the armies of Akanax and Soorenar lay siege to Cimbar. Unable to receive aid from allies, the ruler of Cimbar is forced to sign a pact that severely restricts his power. However, Akanax refuses to sign, instead declaring its own lord as the true king of Chessenta.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 122

events.text: The Tokiryo War is fought in Wa, leading to the rise of the Matasuuri clan.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 6

events.text: A mind flayer cult establishes the city of Ch'Chitl, intending that it be an adjunct to Skullport
Roadaeron Lorndessar II, a future King of Westgate, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: A band of Selûnite adventurers led by Fassa battle a huge force of undead in the Sepulcher of the Dim. Though they are victorious, Fassa is the sole survivor.
Ellusk Baergil is promoted to Captain of the Riders of Mistledale.
cites: Candlekeep forum: Questions for Ed Greenwood (2011): Captain Baergil

events.text: Maeraedryn Lorndessar, a future King of Westgate, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: Shalara of the Seven Kisses, a high-ranking priestess of Auril and wielder of the Silver Supplicant, is killed when she is attacked by adventurers from Baldur's Gate and mercenaries from Elturel. Her relic is claimed by one of the adventurers, who takes it home with her, tracked by other Aurilians. Auril's followers attack several times, finally breaching the safety of the adventurer's base in the city, only to be decimated by a golem, inside which the Supplicant had been secured. When more Aurilians arrive a month later, the golem is gone.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 85

events.text: Szass Tam and a cabal of Red Wizards slay Nyressa Flass, "the Vampire Zulkir" of Thay. Szass Tam succeeds her as Zulkir of Necromancy. He keeps Nyressa around as a skeleton patrolling his property.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 122
Red Magic

events.text: The now-vanished citadel of Lothtia on the Shining Plains is attacked by the orcs of Thoktor Ironfangs. The citadel is defended by the Paladins of the Hand, twelve champions of Torm, one of whom—Harondath—wields the Veloghon of Vigilance.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 106

events.text: Emperor Wai Long Hwa of T'u Lung passes away in his sleep. Wai Long Sun, his son, succeeds him, becoming the fourth emperor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 122

events.text: Circa: Finder Wyvernspur makes a failed attempt to create a clone of himself.
cites: Song of the Saurials

events.text: The Flame of the Spirit is stolen from a Tymora-worshiping adventurer in Elturel by the thief Fargoth Labbard. The gem incinerates Fargoth, then another thief who stole it from him. Finally, it is safely collected by a servant of the mage Helgarth.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 26

events.text: Szass Tam, the Zulkir of Necromancy in Thay, is forced to become a lich after his army is crushed by the Witches in a failed invasion of Rashemen and he is mortally wounded.
cites: Spellbound: Campaign Guide, с. 110
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 122

events.text: Ri'ola'ven becomes the 21st eadar (emperor) of the shalarin empire of As'arem.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 186

events.text: The orc horde of Krautharr Longfangs is defeated in the Battle of Manyswords near Ulkan.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 114

events.text: The Karanok clan become the Lords of Luthcheq in Chessenta under suspicious circumstances, likely involving assassination. All records of events are destroyed, and no members of the former ruling family survive.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Merith Strongbow is born in Cormanthor. He will become the eldest of the Knights of Myth Drannor.
Crown Prince Palaghard I of Cormyr weds Queen Enchara of Esparin, formerly annexing the latter kingdom into Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Members of the Skeletal Finger infiltrate the lair of the blue dragon Iryklathagra, with the aim of stealing from her famous hoard. Unsuccessful, they only manage to awaken her from her slumber.
King Alzurth of Westgate is slain by Zeladazar the Ghost Sword.
cites: Volo's Guide to All Things Magical, с. 125

events.text: Roadaeron Lorndessar, the King of Westgate, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: The master jewelers of Procampur craft a new crown for the coronation of King Palaghard I of Cormyr. The crown is stolen by the legendary pirate Immurk the Invincible, who raided the merchant ship carrying the precious cargo. The crime is so audacious that Palaghard believes that no one could be so brave, and that the Procampan jewelers must be cheating him instead. He musters his armies and nearly declares war on Procampur before being corrected. The crown is eventually recovered, but is so heavy, grandiose, and ugly that it is only used for a few months.
cites: Pirates of the Fallen Stars, с. 7
Cormyr: A Novel: Hardcover 1996, с. 326
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The Champions Vigilant, knightly order of Tethyr are founded.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 9

events.text: Immurk's crime signifies a rise in piracy on the Inner Sea, and the nations around it began building warships to protect their merchants and root out the pirates from their hideouts.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The farming community of Voonlar is settled by the Moonsea.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Driven by the settling of Voonlar, humans continue to clear the forests south of the Moonsea, which are home to elves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The Halruaan archmage Gideona leads a cabal of wizards known as the Keepers to Skullport, where they assume control of access in and out of the port.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Kymer, bastard son of King Alemander II of Tethyr, is born to an elven mistress.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 32
Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: Queen Ilmara of Impiltur marries Rilaun of Sarshel, a man half her age.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The Gray Druid of the Ash Circle raises an army of treants and forest beasts to destroy all civilization in Amn. His plan is ruined quickly by the Wild Helms adventurers from Waterdeep.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 49–50

events.text: A book looted by the Wild Helms is seized by a priest of Silvanus upon their return to Waterdeep. He identifies it as the Leaves of Green. The priest, Angluth Eriduth, managed to prevent the Wild Helms from taking it back from him only to have it stolen by a thief soon afterward.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 49–50

events.text: The Lash of Loviatar surfaces in the hands of the mercenary general Gordurn at the battle of Yonder Fields.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 49–50

events.text: The Arena Fires: In Calimport, about 3% of the population (though nearly 6,000 gladiators and slaves are killed uncounted due to magical firey blasts in the arena) and 1% of city is wrecked (specifically, the Arena Efreetum, as well as the barracks of those who died uncounted).
cites: Calimport, с. 23

events.text: The community of Firewine was destroyed by spells, transforming the region into a wild magic zone.
cites: Volo's Guide to the Sword Coast, с. 102

events.text: The famous Rose-Red Shield adventuring group loses their leader to a beholder. Only three survive the ensuing revenge-quest and they decide to disband the group, retiring to Broken Blade, a now-vanished hamlet of foresters west of Elversult.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 94–95

events.text: The elven trading community of Firewine was destroyed in spell-battles, most of the population slain, some of which rose as undead.
cites: Volo's Guide to the Sword Coast, с. 102

events.text: The Keepers finish their repairs on the locks of Skullport.
cites: Skullport, с. 20

events.text: Imphras II is born to Queen Ilmara and Rilaun of Impiltur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Imphras II is crowned king of Impiltur at birth. Ilmara's husband Rilaun attempts to seize the throne by force, but is defeated. Ilmara continues to rule as Queen-Regent.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: A potter of Chedoru named Jo He Ting fashions a set of magic bowls that bestow clear thought for the imperial court of T'u Lung.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The Hunabar family is ennobled in Waterdeep.

The frontier village of the Slow Cedric's Gallop on the Southern Pass of the Spine of the World is raided and destroyed during a long winter by a tide of orcs. The following spring, the town is discovered buried under the show tides of the mountains with only the top of village's stone belltower sticking out from the snow.
Ashemmi (born Shemmithil Maraphiir) is born in Silverymoon.
cites: Dragon 357: Volo's Guide: Renegades of Darkhold, с. 74

events.text: Lord Vanrak Moonstar and his followers (calling themselves the Dark Army of the Night) conquer a highly defensible redoubt in the Dark Levels of Undermountain. It becomes known as Vanrakdoom.
cites: City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 45
Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage, с. 231

events.text: The Azuthan abbey of Onter's Pool on the island of Norlorn in the Sea of Fallen Stars is sacked and burned by pirates. The slain priests of the abbey haunt the ruins, casting spells at passers-by.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 108

events.text: Coram IV of House Tethyr is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: Contemplating how to deal with ambitious family members, Emperor Wai Long Sun of T'u Lung eats rice from the enchanted bowls fashioned by potter Jo He Ting, which grant clear thought. However, they do not protect against poison, and he dies. His cousin, Wai Chu Doang becomes the fifth emperor. Exploiting the oath of loyalty, he raises large and strong armies as a defense against the baronial clans and against Shou Lung. His habit of using harsh, military solutions to resolve domestic issues leads to his reign being named "The Law of Fists".
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Dambrathan raiders attack and plunder coastal cities in Estagund, Durpar, and Veldorn.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: In Waterdeep, under orders of the Lords, the hoist is constructed, a huge system of blocks and tackles able to lift vessels over the series of locks connecting the sea to the Port of Shadow.
Cedric Carrathal, future king of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles, is born as the grandson of King Adrian Carrathal.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: Princess Delile Balindre of Impiltur renounces her loyalty to the crown, and leads Telflamm in seceding from the kingdom.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Sunrise Spire is destroyed in a petty war between local lords seeking ownership of the nearby ferry over the Chionthar.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 94

events.text: A thief named Bredisker steals the Tome of Torment but, tiring of the harassment from Ilmatari priests, sells the relic to a priestess of Loviatar named Lalaskra of Ormpetarr near the Thornwood. She takes it home with her.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 101

events.text: A group of malaugrym attack Arunsun Tower. They are defeated by Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun, with the help of Elminster, Hamiklar Wands, and other Waterdhavian mages.
cites: City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 30
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Attacks by the pirate Immurk the Invincible cause Sembia to lose a fleet in the Pirate Isles.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 270
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The third Emperor Chin of Shou Lung passes away, granted the deific name of Pao (Panther) after death. His wife succeeds him as the fourth Emperor Chin, ruling until their son comes of age in 1182 DR.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Ellusk Baergil, Captain of the Riders of Mistledale, dies.
cites: Candlekeep forum: Questions for Ed Greenwood (2011): Captain Baergil

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised): Running the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Rysellan the Dark of the Twisted Rune gains the trust of court wizard Wyvorlaa, giving the Rune political influence in Tethyr.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 21

events.text: 13-year old crown prince Imphras II runs away from Lyrabar to live on the Pirate Isles for 3 years. He is coronated upon his return.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 6

events.text: The Dark Army of the Night infiltrate the High House of Stars via its cellars and slaughter most of the Selûnite clergy before an alarm can be raised. When help arrives, the temple is an inferno of Shadow Magic darkfire. Waterdeep's Firefighters find it nearly impossible to put out the black flames.
cites: City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 45

events.text: The Malaugrym appear in Faerûn.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised): Running the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Vanrak Moonstar turns himself into a Death Knight.

Pirate King Immurk attempts to steal the entire naval fleet of Westgate. The plan is unsuccessful, and several of the ships commandeered by the pirate's buccaneers are destroyed by Westgate's navy. The event becomes known as The Rout of the Pirate King.

links.t: The Rout of the Pirate King

events.text: The bard Paerestus "Smokebeard" of Tsurlagol dies when his home catches fire one morning.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 114

events.text: Eiko becomes shogun of Wa.
cites: Ninja Wars, с. 4

events.text: Paladins in service to Osiris evict the followers of Sebek from the River of Swords and demolish the city of Sekras.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Werecrocodiles surviving the River of Swords clearance migrate to the Adder River delta.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: The Supreme Potentate of Var is killed by Anwir Dupretiskava, a blue dragon disguised as a human. Anwir then purports to be the ruler's distant cousin, and takes the throne.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 123

events.text: Shradin Mulophor, Lord of Bones, undertakes an expedition into the Underhalls. He returns a different man, unstable and erratic. He loses much of the fear and respect he once commanded.

Rhighaermon O'Antlers, a ranger and former nobleman of Waterdeep, successfully leads six other Mielikki-worshipers against Lord Lathamp of Elupar to retrieve Yornar's Trail Companion, a holy relic stolen from the ranger by thieves who'd sold to the lord.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 118

events.text: Drow of House Mylyl in Ched Nasad journey to the Underdark below the Far Forest and commence a magical breeding program to beget an ideal slave race. This project eventually leads to the creation of the chitines.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 125

events.text: Ilphael Lorndessar, the King of Westgate, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 86

events.text: Sememmon is born in Huddagh.
cites: Dragon 357: Volo's Guide: Renegades of Darkhold, с. 72

events.text: The greatest horde of orcs in history gathers in the North and journeys south through Amn, Tethyr, and Calimshan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: The orc horde lays siege to numerous settlements on its march south.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: This horde is known as the Black Horde and defeats the Syl-Pasha and Eldrith the Betrayer.

Suffering a 9-month-long siege, Waterdeep is spared the destruction visited on its neighbors when Ahghairon and his generals introduce griffon mounts to the armed forces. These enable agents to fly over the orcs and out of the city to acquire food and aid.
cites: City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 30

events.text: Alustriel and Storm Silverhand lead a Harper army in defeating the orcs besieging Silverymoon in the Battle of Tumbleskulls. They are aided by the surprise intervention of the archmage Tulrun of the Tent.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Beldarm Truesilver, head of the noble Truesilver family of Cormyr, suspected of being the Hullack Hawk.
cites: Dragon 281: The New Adventures of Volo: Lost Treasures of Cormyr, Part 4, с. 76–77

events.text: Whilst Silverymoon is under siege by the Black Horde, Warlord Khallos Shieldsunder usurps control of the city. He is in turn desposed and usurped by self-styled High Mage Shallos Ethenfrost. Shallos in turn dies in a spell-battle with Alustriel. Alustriel is then chosen by unanimous popular acclaim to rule Silverymoon as High Lady Mage.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: The armies of Amn, while battling with humanoid forces, capture many orcs and force them to work at labor camps in Purskul.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Amn, с. 22

events.text: Errilam, who would become King Errilam I of Tethyr, is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 29

events.text: The Revered Counsellor Totep of Nexala is assassinated by his generals. Zomoc becomes the new Revered Counsellor.
cites: Maztica Campaign Set: A Journey to the True World, с. 27–29

events.text: The Harpers erect the stronghold of Moongleam Tower near Everlund. Construction is overseen by Storm Silverhand the dwarf master stoneworker Gwuildeth Throck.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Lectures to a Youngling, a book written by Arivant, sage of Ormath, is published.
cites: The Candlekeep Collection

events.text: Aglarond and Thesk make an alliance by marriage, as Queen Thara of Aglarond weds Elthar Mindosel of Milvarune, eldest son of Jholnareer.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: One Warrior's Way, a book written by Bhelorn Shavarr, is published.
cites: The Candlekeep Collection

events.text: Rieger Carrathal, future king of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles, is born to Prince Teldin Carrathal.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

cites: Blackstaff: MMP, с. 83–90

events.text: Priamon "Frostrune" Rakesk is banished from Waterdeep by Khelben and the Lords of Waterdeep.
cites: Undermountain: Stardock, с. 14

cites: Underdark, с. 130
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

cites: The Candlekeep Collection

events.text: The comet K'Thoutek is seen in the skies of Toril again. It is said to portend the arrival or birth of a powerful entity.
cites: Realmspace, с. 53

events.text: The Art and the Paths upon which it led me, a book written by Bowgentle, is published.

events.text: Clan Malaug assaults Chaulssin, employing information gather in the Harpstar Wars of 1222 DR. Clan Malaug kidnaps a pregnant concubine of Chaulssin's Patron Grandfather.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: After a much-respected noblewoman of Tethyr is captured and murdered by orcs, vengeful humans massacre orcs across the South in an act of genocide. Surviving orcs remember this as the "Year of Pushing Too Far"
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Dwarves of Ironfang Deep in the Mountains of the Alaoreum inadvertently collapse a mountain on their own city. This effectively ends their war with Turmish.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: The venerable blue dragon Anaglathos comes to Turmish quickly seizes control of the land.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 270
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: The order of the Janessar is founded in Calimshan, its symbol a yellow rose entwined around Torm's holy symbol.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 176

events.text: Horarn Baergil becomes the Captain of the Riders of Mistledale (he would only serve for a few months before his death).
cites: Candlekeep forum: Questions for Ed Greenwood (2011): Captain Baergil

events.text: Warlord Sjorn Sendreth, the Leader of Turmish is slain by Anaglathos.
cites: The Vilhon Reach: Dungeon Master's Reference, с. 12

events.text: Horarn Baergil, Captain of the Riders of Mistledale, dies in battle against brigands.
cites: Candlekeep forum: Questions for Ed Greenwood (2011): Captain Baergil

events.text: Anaglathos, a blue dragon, begins his rule of Turmish.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 6

events.text: Vance Carrathal becomes King of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles after the death of his father.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: King Cedric Carrathal of Callidyrr dies of natural causes.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 33

events.text: Matasuuri Shogoro secretly arranges for ninja to assassinate the leader of the Makino clan, Makino Mansaku, bringing full control of the daimyos of the Makino–Matasuuri alliance to himself.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 6

events.text: Matasuuri Shogoro begins the Summer March and engages in battle against an alliance of daimyo in the plains around the town of Tomo in Wa, a conflict that would last for nearly two years.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 6
Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 165

events.text: Illusk is overrun by orcs of the Bloody Tusks tribe at the end of a nine-year-long siege. The orcs then base themselves out of the ruins, from which they raid neighboring settlements.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: After being under siege for nearly a year, Shogun Matasuuri Shogoro gathers allies from southern Wa and is able to break the siege at Tomo. He strengthens his position during the rest of the summer and prepares to strike.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza

events.text: Prince Elphras of Impiltur constructs a castle near the Great Barrow. Soon after, the castle is abandoned for reasons unknown and the prince disappears.
Duke Suldrian of Baldur's Gate commissions a set of magic plate armor to stroke his vanity, unknowingly ensuring his demise in 1249 DR during the Bread Riots.
Loviatar becomes a popular goddess to worship. Many of the temples to Loviatar in the North that survive into the 14th century are established around this time..
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Darnthal Harpell kills the arrogant Ordrar Talonmist in a spell-duel, which puts the Talonmist family of Westbridge into conflict with the Harpells of Longsaddle.

Having strengthened his position throughout the summer by persuading further daimyo to gather under his leadership as the nation's shogun, Matasuuri Shogoro surprises his enemies by making a push for the capital in the middle of winter. Completely unprepared for such an attack, the central daimyo are defeated in the Battle of Shido Plain. All of Wa officially comes under the shogun's command.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza

events.text: Unidentified assassins kill Elthar, Spell-Prince of Milvarn and husband of Queen Ulae of Aglarond.
The capital of Wa is transferred from Iiso to Uwaji by Matasuuri Shogoro.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 161

events.text: Ri'ola'con becomes the 22nd eadar (emperor) of the shalarin empire of As'arem.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 186

events.text: Masked Lord Kerrigan is uncovered as a betrayer by Ahghairon. Kerrigan has already killed three other Lords and many innocents in a bid for full power, but a battle of magic between the two mages results in Kerrigan's death.
cites: City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 30
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Elminster identifies the Simbul, a sorceress pretending to be weaker than she actually is, as Alassra Shentrantra, one of the Seven Sisters.
cites: The Seven Sisters, с. 9

events.text: An illithid druuth leader attempts to sell Yornar's Trail Companion to the elderly Rhighaermon O'Antlers, having no idea who the man is. After slaying the mind flayer, the wounded ranger flees to the nearest temple of Mielikki, pursued closely by doppelgangers. When he arrives, a lady clad in green, believed to be Mielikki, appears to slay his pursuers and then vanishes with the old man in her arms.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 119

events.text: Ardagast Falconhand, huntsman for King Dhalmass Obarskyr and ancestor of Florin Falconhand.
cites: Dragon 281: The New Adventures of Volo: Lost Treasures of Cormyr, Part 4, с. 78

events.text: Lantan tests the use of bombards for the first time.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised), с. 17

events.text: The book My Sword Points the Way, by Tarrondur Maerinspyke, is first published.
cites: Ed Greenwood Presents Elminster's Forgotten Realms, с. 21

events.text: A band of adventurers led by the paladin Corwin Freas slays Anaglathos, the blue dragon tyrannizing Turmish. Corwin becomes the Lord of Turmish.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Palus Frohm ends a twenty-year-long exploration of the Great Glacier and finishes writing the definitive guide to arctic survival, Blood and Ice: Survival in the Great Glacier.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 7

events.text: The two volume Of the Four Natures, written by Ali Binwar, is published.
cites: The Candlekeep Collection

events.text: King Verovan of Westgate challenges the Red Wizards of Thay to a boat race, and is killed in the ensuing shipwreck.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: Prince Horedel of the Korinn Archipelago dies of illness.
cites: Treasure Hunt, с. 29
Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 27

events.text: After the death of Verovan, Westgate's noble merchant families seek to curb the excesses of monarchs. They create the position of Croamarkh, an elected head of state with a four-year-long term. House Vhammos meanwhile moves into the old royal palace, renaming it Castle Vhammos.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: A year after liberating Turmish, Lord Freas dissolves his own monarchy. In its place, he establishes the Assembly of Stars, a council of free citizens to rule the realm.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: The Lords of Waterdeep formally recognize the merchant gentry of Waterdeep, beginning the city's first noble families. The Ammakyl, Anteos, Brokengulf, Cassalanter, Cragsmere, Durinbold, Eagleshield, Hillgauntlet, Hothemer, Husteem, Illitul, Ilvastarr, Ilzimmer, Irlingstar, Jardeth, Jhansczil, Kothont, Lathkule, Maerklos, Majarra, Margaster, Massalan, Raventree, Thann, and Thongolir families are ennobled.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126
City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 59

cites: Old Empires, с. 8

events.text: In Waterdeep, the first guilds are formed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

events.text: King Jholnareer of Milvarn dies, and is succeeded by Khalreer, his second son. In practice, the kingdom of Milvarn exists in nothing more than its name, having been supplanted by Thesk, and its kingship a worthless title. Khalreer actually rules as one of the Oligarchs of Thesk.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 126

Lord (formerly Duke) Orngrym Cormaeril, head of House Cormaeril in Cormyr.
cites: Dragon 281: The New Adventures of Volo: Lost Treasures of Cormyr, Part 4, с. 77

events.text: Duke Suldrian of Baldur's Gate is killed in the Bread Riots, his death becoming a popular source of tavern jokes and lude songs.

The adventuring bard named Saeraethra, who inhabited the shored of a minor waterway in the Delimbiyr Vale, dies in battle against a band of hobgoblin raiders. The stream is renamed Saeraethra's Stream in her honor.
